about_the_game:
Lindwyrm Soundtrack by Gino L Elßner

Immerse yourself in the dark and mythical world of Lindwyrm with the epic Original Soundtrack! This collection of 14 tracks takes you on an adventure filled with mystery, danger, and triumphant battles. From the mysterious sounds of Coastal Chaos to the haunting atmosphere of Portal to Nowhere, each song brings the dark dungeons and relentless trials of Lindwyrm to life.

ARPG meets Arpeggio

Musically, the soundtrack is driven by arpeggios and rich soundscapes. Tracks like Coastal Chaos and Smoldering Endeavours create deep, atmospheric layers with drone elements and subtle guitar textures. Sanctum of the Many Gates builds on vocal harmonies, giving it an almost sacred feel, while To Catch a Nightmare deconstructs itself, deliberately breaking expectations and creating a tense, gripping atmosphere.

The soundtrack blends powerful compositions with contributions from talented musicians: Alexander Jung on guitar, Albert Ihrke on bass, Lucie Reuter, who adds depth with atmospheric vocal layers, and Guy "Paolo Pierre" Müller, who contributed as a supporting composer on Tread Lightly. Together, they create a soundscape that perfectly captures the dark and mystical atmosphere of Lindwyrm.
